description:
GRAPH-NATIVE realization decisions for the recount faculty (the READ twin of describe_utterance.json). project_read_scene ingests each read predication's RAW structure onto a Concept node WITHOUT deciding anything: the agent/patient entity's FULL cased surface (recount_agent / recount_patient -- no head-collapse), the past-inflected predicate surface (recount_pred), the raw predicate lemma (recount_pred_lemma), and the raw slugs (recount_agent_slug / recount_patient_slug). THESE RULES make the decisions that used to be Python (recount_faculty.head_surface / is_function_predicate, both deleted): (1) recount_event_realizable DECIDES a predication is a realizable event iff its predicate lemma is NOT a closed-class preposition -- the held codebook is the Lit list below (the SAME In-over-Lit shape gap_awareness.json uses for its deficiency/self-word cue sets), so a mis-extracted preposition predicate ('of', from 'promoted the burning OF fossil fuels') is NOT realized; (2) recount_residual_mark DECIDES the complement is a named reading residual (recount_residual) the host reports honestly, never faked; (3) recount_say_agent / _event / _patient route the raw fields into the produce-frame slots the host reads back and speaks through LanguageProduction.produce -- realizing the WHOLE entity ('Justice Department', 'Public Citizen'), not just its head. Ablating recount_event_realizable makes the 'of' line realize (the skip is the rule's decision); ablating a say_* rule drops that slot (the realization is the rule's decision). Anchored on ['p','is_a','con'] (the SAME percept->concept edge the composed communicate_what_i_read rule reads); every rule is guarded by recount_pred_lemma!=null so it fires ONLY on recount concepts and never on any other agent's graph.

v1.1.0 -- THE COPULAR FIX (filed as a SelfConcern gap: 'renders is_a wrongly'). project_read_scene's mechanical +ed morphology bridge (_past_surface) is a REGULAR-verb bridge; applied uniformly to the closed-class predicate lemma 'is_a' (a copular/designation predication -- 'a spokesman CALLED the critics misinformed' reads as is_a(spokesman, critics) on this pipeline; see the module's own honest note that reading_collapse's construction tag distinguishing genuine taxonomic is_a from a copular 'called X Y' does not survive onto this read path) it mis-produces the non-word 'is_aed'. recount_say_event now EXCLUDES the is_a lemma (added guard below) and the new recount_say_event_copular rule renders it with the held copular surface 'called' instead -- the SAME 'a rule's own literal is graph-resident, ablatable data' pattern seeds/recount_analysis_realization.json already uses for its five say_event literals (signalled/marked/reversed/revealed/leaned), not a Python if rel=='is_a'. This does not claim to recover the true source verb 'called' from the mis-collapsed dyadic (rel,a0,a1) triple (the complement 'misinformed' is dropped upstream, a separate honest reading-layer residual, not fixed here) -- it only stops rendering an ungrammatical non-word. Ablating recount_say_event_copular reverts to no say_event at all for an is_a concept (recount_say_event's own exclusion guard keeps it from filling in 'is_aed' either) -- an HONEST silence rather than a wrong word, proving the copular surface is this rule's own decision.
